name: Collar
long_description:
We are a team of ex-intelligence, ex-finance, and most importantly, ex-founders who have known each other for over 5 years.

Collar is redefining investor relations. 

Right now, investor relations is an under-appreciated yet sweeping function. 
They have a bird’s eye view of what external stakeholders want, and also work with internal business units to create a grand vision of a company’s future.

But they’re doing it with their hands tied behind their back.

Finance AI tools today are built for investors not investor relations, leaving teams using ad-hoc unreliable workarounds, and CFOs are stuck always reporting rather than acting on insights to optimize operational workstreams.

Before earning calls, Collar prepares CFOs through proactive earnings calls prep, investor targeting and fully citation-backed live teleprompters, saving them hours of work.

After earning calls, CFOs use Collar’s trusted agentic AI systems to optimize identified underperforming workstreams with little manual modification needed. 

Redefining investor relations from a tedious cost centre headache, into a whole-of-company profit maximising function.

launches.title: Collar: The AI for public company Investor Relations
launches.tagline: Find the right investors. Prepare for earnings. Answer analyst questions live with approved company information.
launches.body:
Collar is the AI for public company investor relations.

IR teams must know the whole company, its investors and the market. That knowledge lives across spreadsheets, emails, transcripts, teams and data providers.

Collar turns mess into momentum. 

**Turns company context into a live teleprompter for the CEO**\
Collar's teleprompter surfaces the right figure, commitment or approved line the moment a question lands. Management answers with precision on every earnings call.

**Turns repeat questions into instant answers**\
Collar's Q&A bot lives on your IR website and answers investor questions from your filings, transcripts and approved messaging. Anything sensitive goes to IR’s inbox first.

**Turns memory into meetings that matter**\
Collar remembers every investor relationship since your IPO. It shows you a CRM of who to meet, why now, and gives you a brief before you walk in.

**Turns scattered data into decisions**\
Collar reconciles conflicting information across departments, resolves who and what each data point refers to, checks freshness, so management can use an answer without having to manually verify it again.

Kazel and Jamie are second time founders with backgrounds in buy side investing and military intelligence. For two years, they have built AI that gathers intelligence from hard to reach places and turns it into action. They know how investors think because they have sat on that side of the table.

Send us your ticker on [usecollarai.com](http://usecollarai.com)\
We'll send you 10 portfolio managers you should target next quarter.
